notes.title: Wingspan Patch - July 14th
notes.notes:
[b][h2]Birders,[/h2]

[h2]A real chonky patch just landed on Steam![/h2][/b]
[h3]This update fixes a bunch of bugs you’ve reported since the Asia Expansion launch, bringing improved performance and stability, and including a few small changes to birds you know well by now!

[b]Here’s what changed in the patch:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will not be able to back out from playing Wrybill after already seeing the discard pile
[*] Wingspans updated for Count Raggis Bird of Paradise, Horsfields Bushlark, Malleefowl, Pesquets Parrot, Pheasant Coucal
[/list]
[b]Here’s what’s been fixed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Wetland bonus conversions allowing for indefinite activations when used alternately.
[*] 'Historian' bonus card displaying an incorrect % of birds.
[*] #ERROR displaying instead of the sum of wingspans during push-your-luck powers in German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Japanese, and Italian.
[*] Grey Butcherbird tucking birds with a 40 cm wingspan.
[*] Some bird powers rerolling dice being not predictible in Champ of the Birds mode.
[*] Pink powers not allowing the reset of the birdfeeder when triggered by Automa.
[*] "Fewest Duet tokens on bonus spaces" goal not displaying correctly on Automa's screen.
[*] Birds in the online menu covering active games.
[*] Black Drongo and Red-Wattled Lapwing not displaying the "no return" arrow appropriately during activation.
[*] AI placing Duet tokens on spaces with beak pointing left/right when playing a bird pointing forward.
[*] Playing a second bird in the same turn (via another bird's power) in Duet mode unable to be undone.
[*] Resetting the tray with a Duet token when selecting a card in the tray being inconsistent for Yellow Bittern compared with other card-drawing powers.
[*] "Refill Tray" option displaying as active after resetting the tray with a Duet token.
[*] Bluethroat and Common Nightingale's powers not displaying the "back" button in some cases.
[*] Eurasian Collared-Dove not counting towards Anatomist bonus card
[*] Issues when playing Montagu's Harrier and Southern Cassowary in overview mode.
[*] Paying food costs with seed cached on Coal Tit not allowing placing duet token on appropriate space
[*] Food cached on Coal Tit restoring more than it should when player undoes playing bird action
[*] Satyr Tragopan not restoring card when undoing its power
[*] Playing Rose-Ringed Parakeet in overview mode
[*] Minor Tutorial fixes.
[*] Minor UI and sound fixes.
[*] Global Analyst Achievement not unlocking after scoring a bonus card with Red-Crowned Crane and Great Indian Bustard's powers, and not taking copied bonus cards into account.
[/list]
[b]For those of you playing with a controller, we’ve made a few improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] The "undo" action available when a pop-up to confirm an action was active.
[*] Trying to play a bird without the required food using a GAME END power, displaying a non-interactive pop-up.
[*] Backing out of the Grassland bonus conversion action resulting in the controller losing focus. 
[/list]
Thanks so much for all your feedback and reports, they are always a huge help! 
We hope this update smooths things out and makes your experience even better. And of course, we hope you’re enjoying the Asia Expansion!

Have a great week,
Monster Couch Team[/h3]

Birders! 
A new patch is flying your way!
In this update, we introduce a couple of new features and a handful of bug fixes to improve Wingspan and bring you the best experience we can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/378a5a35fbcc0477b803921902496f417f78ffb1.png[/img]

[*] Fix for Eurasian Collared-Dove and Common Starling not tucking cards when using nectar as an option to discard.
[*] Fix for House Wren's power letting players to play a bird in an incorrect habitat.
[*] Kakapo's power will now inform players that the bonus card deck is empty.
[*] Minor power fixes for Pukeko, Kea, Greater Flamingo, Common Chaffinch, and Common Chiffchaff. 
[*] Mac: Fix for empty tooltips appearing on some devices.

Thank you so much for your reports and feedback! 
Please remember to update your game!

notes.title: [UPDATE] Online Maintenance - April 5th
notes.notes:
[h3]Birders!

Our servers are now back up and running!

You can now access the Online mode and create new games. Unfortunately, fixing the problem took its toll, and games started before yesterday’s incident were deleted. We are deeply sorry for this, but it was unavoidable. 

We are still observing the server's behavior. We feel rather optimistic about it, but we want you to know there’s still a risk of an issue. We hope it will remain stable, but we stay alert. 

Right now we’re keeping in touch with our online service provider to work out this situation and prevent such events in the future.

Thank you for your patience and for staying with us. We are very grateful for all your support, especially in moments like this one. We're working hard to provide you with the best online experience. Please rest assured that we’ll do our best to make it happen.

Have a good weekend[/h3]

notes.title: Deck Update Alert: Bye-bye Ravens!
notes.notes:
[h3]Hey Birders,

You were chirping, we listened! You will be able to UNRAVEN your Wingspan games![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35583524/78f432bb662717ab5483661e9c6c9d2676453547.gif[/img]

[h3]With the upcoming release of Wingspan: Oceania Expansion, we will introduce the rulebook’s suggestion and give all players an option to ditch the Chihuahuan Raven and Common Raven in single-player and custom multiplayer games! The option will also be available to all Birders who do not have Oceania Expansion.

Fed up with the constant cawing? No worries. Customize your deck pre-game and say farewell to those black-feathered individuals. Tailor your gaming experience to suit your style.

*******

While waiting for the Oceania Expansion release, we’d like to invite you to help us with online beta testing of our second game, Quilts & Cats of Calico!

If you like cozy puzzle games and would like to help us with development and growth as a studio, we invite you to sign up in the form below*:
[url=https://forms.gle/R3SM55GVXFJNM8LLA]https://forms.gle/R3SM55GVXFJNM8LLA[/url]

*If you’ve already signed up for our previous beta tests for Quilts & Cats of Calico, you don’t have to do it again.


That’s it for today. Stay tuned for other eggciting news!


P.S. We’re celebrating the Soon™ anniversary so our beachy Oceania background is again available! Play with it until November 29th. We have come a long way since then and Wingspan has undergone many changes and improvements in its backend. Thank you for being with us all this time and supporting us in our work.
[/h3]

notes.title: Help Us Test Base Version of Wingspan
notes.notes:
[h2]Birders of Steam![/h2]

[h3]The release of Wingspan: European Expansion is coming very soon (we recommend you to keep checking our social media & Discord 😉). When building the DLC we have introduced some changes and optimizations to the base game, Wingspan itself. We would like to test them before the release of the European Expansion.

We want Wingspan and its expansion to run smoothly for you, to have as few bugs as possible and to give you a lot of fun. Therefore, we would like to invite you to help us test Wingspan! If you want to feel like part of the development team, then this is a great occasion![/h3]

[h2][b]TESTS APPLY TO THE BASE VERSION OF WINGSPAN ONLY[/b][/h2]

[h2][b]What do you need to do to participate?[/b][/h2]

[h3]If you own the game Wingspan on Steam, right-click on the game in your library, and click Properties. Select the [b]BETAS[/b] tab, and select the[b] public_test_realm[/b] branch. You will then get to the test version of the game.

[b]NOTE[/b] Finding an online matchmaking partner on the [b]public_test_realm[/b] branch may be harder than on the default one. If you want to play back on the base version of Wingspan with regular players, select [b]NONE[/b] in the [b]BETAS[/b] tab in the game [b]Properties[/b].[/h3]

[h2][b]How can you help?[/b][/h2]

[h3]First of all, by reporting bugs! Please include a description of what actions you took before the problems occurred. Also, there are a couple of good ways to report issues:

[b]1. Submit a bug report through the in-game bug reporting system[/b]

Click on a bubble with a worm inside that will appear in the upper left corner of the screen and describe your problem.

[b]2. Describe the bug on a dedicated channel on Discord[/b]

Join our Discord [b][url=https://discord.gg/Enwr4z4rXd]HERE[/url][/b]. In the Announcements channel, you will find the 🎯 emoji below the post. Click on it and you will get access to a hidden channel specifically for Wingspan testers.

[b]3. Send us a ticket along with the relevant files to support@monstercouch.com[/b]

If a bug you encounter causes the game to break completely (e.g. when it crashes or freezes) you can send us the player and player-prev log files by e-mail. This will help us look into the problem better. Besides the files, remember to describe the issue and write [b][WINGSPAN BETA][/b] in the title of the e-mail. Below you can find information on where to look for the Player and Player-prev files:

PC log location:
C:Users[username]AppData/LocalLow/MonsterCouch/Wingspan/Player.log

Game log location on Mac:
  ~/Library/Logs/MonsterCouch/Wingspan/Player.log
 
[url=https://www.macrumors.com/how-to/reveal-library-folder-in-macos/ ]https://www.macrumors.com/how-to/reveal-library-folder-in-macos/ [/url]


Our birders' eagle eyes have helped us catch even the most insidious bugs more than once, so we're counting on your help!
[/h3]

notes.title: Spring is here! March 25 update
notes.notes:
Chirp, chirp chirp. Chirp!

More chirps, more birbs, more sun - spring is here! 

It's a lovely season, when the nature comes back to life. One place in particular is known for a phenomenon that compliments this season in a beautiful way. 

We've added a new background, inspired by ths place, to celebrate Spring! Can you guess what it is by looking at the pictures? You probably can, but we'll still keep it a secret! Launch Wingspan to find out! There's also a special spring "Champ of the Birds" challenge coming in a few days!

Here's a quick list rundown, because everyone loves lists, especially during spring... right?

[b]Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] new, limited-time spring background added
[*] Spring "Champ of the Birds" challenge coming on 29th March
[/list]

As always, there's an interaction hidden in the background. Click away to find it!

Enjoy Spring, enjoy playing Wingspan and stay safe!

It was delicious. 

Here's a list of what types of bugs we used in case you want to make your own. In other words, here's what's been fixed:

[b]Bugfixes:[/b][list]
[*] fixed the turn pop-up not disappearing in some instances
[*] fixed the online game disconnect pop-up - when another player leaves the game, the text on the pop-up will now properly reflect that
[/list]

Hopefully these changes make your online experience better and the spaghetti will turn out as tasty as ours.

As awlays, thank you so much for being a part of the Wingspan community. As always, let us know if there's anything we might help with. Also, be sure to join our fantastic Discord community - discord.gg/wingspan.

Even though this year has been filled with uneasiness and stress for just about anyone, we hope you'll be able to find time to unwind and relax as we enter this holiday season. Since Wingspan is a game that aims to relax and wind you down, we decided to bring a little holiday magic to your beautiful preserves.

notes.title: Don't get spooked - Become the Champ of the Birds! Wingspan Halloween update!
notes.notes:
Do you hear that?

Someone... something's knocking on the window. You try to see what it is, but you can't. The thick fog outside, illuminated only by the faint candlelight of the Halloween pumpkin on the windowsill, makes it hard to distinguish shapes. As you get closer, the silhouette becomes sharper, clearer. A chill goes down your spine. You might not have been expecting it, but it's here nonetheless...

The Wingspan Halloween update! It's big and spooky and if you're expecting treats, it's got plenty! 

[list]
[*] [b]NEW MODE: Champ of the Birds[/b] - this completely new game mode is a weekly ladder for those of you birders who like to compete. Each week, you face an entirely new Automa challenge. Once you beat it, your score is saved and at the end of each week, the person who managed to score the most points is crowned as the Champ of the Birds! 

[*] [b]Halloween background[/b] - this sinister, foggy landscape will be available in the game for the duration of the Halloween event. 

[*] [b]Bugfixes[/b]:
- fix for playing a second bird via bird power on the overview screen
- fix for "repeat a brown power" on the overview screen
- cards on the Automa screen that should not be clickable are no longer clickable
- fix for some typos
- fix for warning popups on overview screen

[*][b]Misc[/b]:
- Chinese voice over and card fixes (some birds have better names now)
[/list]


And remember - don't get spooked... if you get hooked (on playing Wingspan)!

We hope you enjoy the new mode and the fixes make the experience better. As always, let us know if there's anything we might help with. Also, be sure to join our fantastic Discord community - [b]discord.gg/wingspan[/b].

notes.title: Wingspan Patch Notes - 10/08 Update

Hey, bird enthusiasts! 

We’re back with another set of fixes that should make the game more relaxing to play (because less bugs and qol changes, yay!). It might also make you grow feathers, but this is a known side-effect - don’t panic and consult your doctor if you start seeing feather growing symptoms. 

Here's the list of changes, additions and fixes:

- Introduced a way to quickly switch between online matches through the Pause menu.
- Local custom games setup will now remember your last setup.
- Entering the Overview screen during setup hides the setup now.
- Clicking on another player’s portrait to see their game area will now also display their “last action taken” pop-up.
- “Repeat a brown power to repeat a brown power to repeat a brown power to repeat a brown power” bug fixed.
- Player names in online games will now be visible on the end-game screen.
- Interjection popups fixed for leaving to the main menu and coming back to the game.
- Fixed an issue with AI spamming the log.
- Fixed a number of issues related to match slots in the online menu.
- Fixed a number of issues related to how end-of-round goals were calculated.
- Fixed a number of issues in localizations.
- Fixed a number of typos.

As always, if you encounter any issues while playing, please drop us a line at support@monstercouch.com or let us know via our discord: https://discord.gg/wingspan, where you can also chat with fellow players.

And, if you're enjoying Wingspan, please consider taking a moment to leave a review -- they can go a long way in helping new players discover the game.

Thanks for your support!
Monster Couch Team
